retirement_age.notes: 60 is the statutory mandatory retirement age at workplaces. National Pension old-age eligibility is currently 63 and rises by one year every five years to 65 by 2033. Bills to raise the mandatory retirement age to 65 are under discussion and are not law as of the sources found.

political_system: presidential republic; the president is both head of state and head of government; the Prime Minister is a senior cabinet member appointed by the president with National Assembly approval
